name: Unfinished Graphite Drawing
name_es: Lámina a lápiz a medio hacer
swap_rule: Reference this style ID and change subject framing only; do not rewrite the page, real hand, or sharpener.

properties.subject: Centered frontal half-body or full-body portrait, looking at the viewer, still expression
properties.placement: Figure floats within page edges, with extra bottom and side margins
properties.drawing: Graphite drawing on beige paper with detailed eyes, hair strands and finely drawn skin
properties.face: Carefully detailed face with visible strokes at hair and edges
properties.clothes: Do not reproduce garments; indicate clothing only with lines
properties.paper: Textured Cambridge silk beige paper with graphite smudges and dust
properties.hand: Real hand with pencil from bottom right touching unfinished drawing
properties.sharpener: Metal pencil sharpener at upper right, shavings and graphite dust
properties.contrast: Photographic hand, pencil and sharpener against graphite subject
properties.forbid: Action poster, collage, neon, backlight, sky, scenery, signature on skin, URL, cursor, watermark, pulp or movie poster, occluded subject
